findings.whyWrong: These are full-size molecular assemblies appearing or disappearing inside the scene without approach or clearance. findings.fix: Smooth entry contributions for assembling RecA and incoming RNAP, and give already-cleaved LexA fragments a finite dispersal/clearance interval before hiding. Use existing prebuilt nodes and independently owned materials or transforms so neighboring DNA/proteins do not fade. Retain noncleavable repression and RNA timing.
